title: AgentEvent
description: One record of something an AI coding agent did, as the SigDek recorder writes it. The recorder and the hosted service both generate their types from this file. `hash` is the SHA-256 of the record's RFC 8785 canonical JSON with the `hash` field removed; `prev` is the previous record's `hash` on the same device.

ts.description: When the recorder wrote the record, UTC, millisecond precision.

seq.description: Position in this device's chain, starting at 1.

prev.description: Hash of the previous record on this device; 64 zeros for the first.

device.description: Device id, generated on the machine and registered at sign-in.

user.description: Signed-in user's email; null before sign-in.

session.description: The agent tool's session or conversation id.

prompt_id.description: Groups actions under the prompt that caused them.

remote.description: Normalized origin remote, e.g. github.com/acme/api; credentials removed.

root_hash.description: SHA-256 of the repository root path, so local-only repositories stay distinct without revealing the path.

name.description: The tool's own name for the action.

path.description: File actions only; relative to the repository root when inside it, ~ for the home directory otherwise.

url.description: Web actions only, credentials and query secrets stripped.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the tool input; the input itself is never stored. When the record's `redactions` is 0, it is the hash of the tool input exactly as the agent sent it (its JSON bytes, surrounding whitespace trimmed; `null` when there was none). That covers parts not stored, such as a file's contents, so it can confirm a guess at the whole input. When `redactions` is above 0, a secret was stripped from the command, path or URL, and it is instead the hash of the stored, redacted action, so it can't confirm a guess at the secret: the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of an object holding this action's `kind` and `name`, and its `command`, `path` and `url` where present, and nothing else. For example, {"command":"mysql -u root -p[redacted] -h db.internal","kind":"shell","name":"Bash"}. Anyone holding the record can recompute it.

outcome.description: What happened to the action: it ran, failed, was stopped by a Block rule (denied_by_rule) or was refused by the agent tool or its user (denied). attempted: recorded before the action ran because it changes SigDek's own setup; whether it then ran isn't known (a later record for the same call, when there is one, says).

rule.description: Id of the sensitive-action or deny rule that matched.

permission_mode.description: Claude Code only; absent on some events.

redactions.description: How many secret values were stripped from this record. On an action record, a count above 0 also means `action.input_hash` is the hash of the stored, redacted action, not of the tool input as sent (see `input_hash`).
